```{r}
setwd("~/Césure/Tahiti")
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
po <- read_excel("Data_Globale_Tahiti.xlsx", sheet = "PO")

# Nettoyage + création PO
po <- po %>%
  filter(LATIN_SPECIES != "Nom espèce") %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(DATE),
    PO_ID = paste(ENR, Date, sep = "_")
  )
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

po <- po %>%
  mutate(
    genus = word(LATIN_SPECIES, 1),
    species = word(LATIN_SPECIES, 2),
    sp_short = paste0(
      str_sub(genus, 1, 3), "_",
      str_sub(species, 1, 3)
    )
  )
```
Proportion de PO occupés par espèce
```{r}
# Nombre total de PO (tous conservés)
n_po_total <- po %>%
  distinct(PO_ID) %>%
  nrow()

prop_po_species <- po %>%
  distinct(PO_ID, sp_short, STATUS) %>%   # présence/absence + statut
  group_by(sp_short, STATUS) %>%
  summarise(
    n_po_occ = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_po = n_po_occ / n_po_total)
```

```{r}
status_colors <- c(
  "Introduit" = "#F4A6A6",  # Introduced (pastel red)
  "Natif"     = "#A8D5A2",  # Native (pastel green)
  "Marin"     = "#A7C7E7"   # Marine (pastel blue)
)

status_labels <- c(
  "Introduit" = "Introduced",
  "Natif"     = "Native",
  "Marin"     = "Marine"
)
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  prop_po_species,
  aes(
    x = reorder(sp_short, -prop_po),
    y = prop_po,
    fill = STATUS
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = status_colors,
    labels = status_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Proportion in point counts",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
Graph 2, Total detection pour chaque espèce
```{r}
prop_detection_species <- po %>%
  group_by(sp_short, STATUS) %>%
  summarise(
    n_det = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_det = n_det / sum(n_det))
```


```{r}
ggplot(
  prop_detection_species,
  aes(
    x = reorder(sp_short, -prop_det),
    y = prop_det,
    fill = STATUS
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = status_colors,
    labels = status_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Proportion of detections",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
presence_site <- po %>%
  group_by(ENR) %>%
  summarise(
    Acridotheres_tristis = ifelse(
      any(sp_short == "Acr_tri"),
      "Présent",
      "Absent"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
data_plot <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  left_join(presence_site, by = c("Enr" = "ENR"))

ggplot(
  data_plot,
  aes(
    x = Enr,
    y = `N/E`,
    color = Acridotheres_tristis
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Absent"  = "#2A9D8F",
      "Présent" = "#E76F51"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Site",
    y = "N/E",
    color = "Acridotheres tristis"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```
```{r}
ggplot(
  data_plot,
  aes(
    x = Acridotheres_tristis,
    y = `N/E`,
    color = Acridotheres_tristis
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Absent" = "#2A9D8F", "Présent" = "#E76F51")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "N/E"
  )
```
Pour l'anayse des fichiers en 30m...
```{r}
set.seed(123)

results_file_30min <- data.frame(
  projet = character(),
  fichier = character(),
  ACI_val = numeric(),
  ADI_val = numeric(),
  AEI_val = numeric(),
  BIO_val = numeric(),
  H_val = numeric(),
  M_val = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_30min))) {

  # ----- Sélection 1 fichier sur 2 sans biais -----
  paire <- ceiling(i / 2)

  analyser <- if (paire %% 2 == 1) {
    i %% 2 == 1    # paire impaire → 1er fichier
  } else {
    i %% 2 == 0    # paire paire → 2e fichier
  }

  if (!analyser) {
    cat("Ignoré (règle paire) :", df_30min$fichier[i], "\n")
    next
  }

  # ----- Infos fichier -----
  wav_path <- df_30min$chemin[i]
  projet   <- df_30min$projet[i]
  fichier  <- df_30min$fichier[i]

  # ----- Extraction 5 minutes aléatoires -----
  wav_5min <- extraire_5min_alea_mem(wav_path)

  if (is.null(wav_5min)) {
    cat("Ignoré (lecture impossible) :", fichier, "\n")
    next
  }

  # ----- Calcul indices -----
  fs <- wav_5min@samp.rate

  ACI <- seewave::ACI(wav_5min, f = fs)
  ADI <- soundecology::acoustic_diversity(wav_5min)
  AEI <- soundecology::acoustic_evenness(wav_5min)
  BIO <- soundecology::bioacoustic_index(wav_5min)
  H   <- seewave::H(wav_5min, f = fs)
  M   <- seewave::M(wav_5min, f = fs)

  # ----- Stockage résultats -----
  results_file_30min <- rbind(
    results_file_30min,
    data.frame(
      projet = projet,
      fichier = fichier,
      ACI_val = ACI,
      ADI_val = ADI,
      AEI_val = AEI,
      BIO_val = BIO,
      H_val = H,
      M_val = M
    )
  )

  rm(wav_5min)
  gc(FALSE)

  cat("OK :", fichier, "\n")
}
```
